findings.description: The rewrite only removes names found in `param.opts` and no longer removes names found in `param.secondary_opts`, which the old code also removed.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command defines a boolean flag with a secondary option, such as `--shout/--help`, or a secondary name like `-h`, that collides with a help option name. The old code removed the name from the help option names. The new code keeps it, so the help option is registered with a conflicting name and either shadows the user's option or makes parsing ambiguous. The title says only that order is preserved, so dropping the secondary_opts loop is an unintended behavior change.
